# Abeó Health

> Abeó Health is a health & community support network in South Orange County,
> California. Two ways we help today: free community resource navigation
> (Community Outreach) and senior placement guidance — a real person listens
> first, then points you to the right resource, even when it isn't us.
> Tagline: "Care, coordinated. Because health is everything."
> Philosophy: High Tech, High Touch — technology enables efficiency, but people
> deliver trust.

## What Abeó Health is

Abeó Health, LLC is a community front door for families navigating aging and
care in South Orange County, California (Laguna Niguel / Laguna Hills /
Saddleback area). A real person listens to the whole situation, helps name what
is actually needed, and routes you to the right resource — including resources
outside Abeó.

- Entity: Abeó Health, LLC
- Region served: South Orange County, California
- Address: 28100 Cabot Rd. Suite 232, Laguna Niguel, CA 92677
- Phone: (949) 987-4605
- Email: info@abeo.health
- Website: https://abeo.health

## Services available today

- **Community Outreach (free resource navigation):** The free front door for
  families who do not yet know who to call. Tell us what is happening; we help
  work out what kind of help it is and where it lives — care, housing,
  transport, benefits, respite, or something else — and refer you to the right
  resource, agency, or provider, including ones outside Abeó. No charge, no
  obligation. Details: https://abeo.health/services/outreach

- **Senior Placement Support:** Guidance for families understanding and
  exploring senior living options — independent living, assisted living, memory
  care, and skilled nursing. Free to families: there is never a fee to families
  for placement support. Where a placement occurs, senior communities may
  compensate Abeó — never you — and we are transparent about referral
  relationships. Details: https://abeo.health/services/living

## In development — not currently offered

Other services (non-medical home care, non-emergency medical transportation,
care coordination with a family dashboard, and clinical home health tiers) are
in development and are not currently offered. Abeó does not currently hold a
home care license and does not provide home care today.

## Who it serves

Families in South Orange County, California navigating aging and care for
loved ones — especially those who do not yet know what kind of help they need
or who to call first.

## Key facts

- Community Outreach is free — a resource, not a service we sell.
- Senior placement support is free to families; compensation, when it occurs,
  comes from the receiving community and is disclosed.
- Abeó points families to the right resource even when that resource is not
  Abeó.
